name: Link Button
description: An inline text action styled as a link, with an underline that draws in on hover and focus.

props.name: href
props.description: When given, renders a link (<a>). Without it, renders a button that takes onPress.

props.name: tone
props.description: Water-coloured text, body ink, or muted text that turns to ink on hover.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Icon after the text. Nudges 2 pixels to the right on hover.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Link or Button.
